_comment: Synthetic dictation cleanup evals (fictional names). Run them against your cleanup model through POST /glasses/v1/voice/cleanup; test/voice-context.test.mjs checks the pass conditions. Checks: contains/notContains are case-insensitive substrings, containsExact is case-sensitive, matches/notMatches are case-insensitive regexes, equalsLoose compares lowercased words without punctuation, minOverlap is the share of raw words (4+ letters) kept, mentions lists the expected participant ids. 'people' names a participant set below; t3 cases use the fallback vocabulary in t3-vocab.json.
